preinstalled.name: Microsoft News
preinstalled.explanation: Headlines from MSN. News sites work the same in your browser without it.

preinstalled.name: Weather
preinstalled.explanation: The MSN weather app. The forecast on the taskbar is part of Widgets and is not affected.

preinstalled.name: Money
preinstalled.explanation: An MSN finance app Microsoft no longer updates.

preinstalled.name: Sports
preinstalled.explanation: An MSN sports app Microsoft no longer updates.

preinstalled.name: Get Help
preinstalled.explanation: Opens Microsoft's support chat. Support works in the browser at support.microsoft.com too.

preinstalled.name: Tips
preinstalled.explanation: Introductory tips about Windows features.

preinstalled.name: Solitaire Collection
preinstalled.explanation: Card games with ads. Scores sync to your Microsoft account if you signed in.

preinstalled.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
preinstalled.explanation: The app formerly called Office: a launcher for Office on the web with Copilot and Microsoft 365 offers. Word, Excel and other installed Office apps are separate and keep working.

preinstalled.name: Feedback Hub
preinstalled.explanation: Sends feedback and bug reports to Microsoft. Windows works the same without it.

preinstalled.name: Maps
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft's offline-capable map app, which Microsoft is retiring. Any maps you downloaded for offline use go with it.

preinstalled.name: Movies & TV
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft's old video store and player. Videos you own play in Media Player, and purchases stay in your account.

preinstalled.name: Cortana
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft retired Cortana. The app no longer does anything.

preinstalled.name: Mixed Reality Portal
preinstalled.explanation: Sets up Windows Mixed Reality headsets, which Microsoft discontinued. Only useful if you still use one.

preinstalled.name: Skype
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft shut Skype down in 2025. Your contacts and chats moved to Teams if you chose to.

preinstalled.name: People
preinstalled.explanation: An old contacts app. Your contacts live in your Microsoft or mail account, not in the app.

preinstalled.name: Messaging
preinstalled.explanation: An old text messaging app Microsoft no longer updates.

preinstalled.name: Mobile Plans
preinstalled.explanation: Buys mobile data plans for PCs with a SIM slot. Only useful if your PC has one.

preinstalled.name: Print 3D
preinstalled.explanation: An old 3D printing app Microsoft has retired.

preinstalled.name: 3D Builder
preinstalled.explanation: An old 3D modelling app Microsoft has retired.

preinstalled.name: 3D Viewer
preinstalled.explanation: Views 3D model files. Microsoft has retired it.

preinstalled.name: Dev Home
preinstalled.explanation: A developer dashboard Microsoft discontinued in 2025.
A King game (like Candy Crush) that came preinstalled. If you never played it, nothing is lost.
A Disney app that came preinstalled as a promotion.

preinstalled.name: TikTok
preinstalled.explanation: Preinstalled as a promotion. Your account and videos live online.
A Meta app that came preinstalled as a promotion. Your account lives online.

preinstalled.name: LinkedIn
preinstalled.explanation: Preinstalled as a promotion. Your account lives online and works in the browser.

preinstalled.name: Enjoy Office (promotion)
preinstalled.explanation: A preinstalled promotion for Microsoft Office. Office itself is not affected.

preinstalled.name: Clipchamp
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft's video editor. Projects you made and did not back up to the cloud are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: Media Player
preinstalled.explanation: Windows' music and video player. Your files stay, but you need another player to open them.

preinstalled.name: Phone Link
preinstalled.explanation: Connects an Android phone or iPhone to your PC for texts, calls and photos.

preinstalled.name: Xbox
preinstalled.explanation: The Xbox app and PC Game Pass. Keep it if you install or launch games through it.

preinstalled.name: Game Bar
preinstalled.explanation: The Win+G overlay for screen recording and game captures. Keep it if you record clips.

preinstalled.name: Microsoft Teams
preinstalled.explanation: Teams for work or school. Remove it only if you do not use Teams.

preinstalled.name: Microsoft Teams (personal)
preinstalled.explanation: Teams for personal chats. Your chats live in your Microsoft account.

preinstalled.name: Outlook (new)
preinstalled.explanation: The new Outlook mail app. Your mail stays in your account, but you need another app or the browser to read it.

preinstalled.name: Microsoft To Do
preinstalled.explanation: A task list that syncs to your Microsoft account. Tasks stay in your account.

preinstalled.name: Sticky Notes
preinstalled.explanation: Notes sync to your Microsoft account if you signed in. Notes that never synced are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: Power Automate
preinstalled.explanation: Automates repetitive tasks. Keep it if you built any flows.

preinstalled.name: Copilot
preinstalled.explanation: Microsoft's AI assistant app. Copilot also works in Edge and on the web.

preinstalled.name: Quick Assist
preinstalled.explanation: Lets someone you trust help you remotely. Keep it if family or IT support use it to help you.

preinstalled.name: Journal
preinstalled.explanation: A pen note-taking app. Journals saved only on this PC are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: Spotify
preinstalled.explanation: Often preinstalled as a promotion. Songs downloaded for offline listening are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: Prime Video
preinstalled.explanation: Often preinstalled as a promotion. Downloaded videos are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: Netflix
preinstalled.explanation: Often preinstalled as a promotion. Downloaded episodes are removed with it.

preinstalled.name: McAfee
preinstalled.explanation: A security trial preinstalled by the PC maker. Windows Security keeps protecting your PC without it.
An HP app that came with this PC. Some show warranty details or offer driver updates.
A Lenovo app that came with this PC. Some offer driver and firmware updates.
A Dell app that came with this PC. Some offer driver and firmware updates.
An Acer app that came with this PC.
An ASUS app that came with this PC. Some control laptop features like battery care, updates or the ScreenPad, so check what it does before removing it.
A CyberLink app the PC maker preinstalled, often a trial. Projects saved only inside the app are removed with it.
